annotations.title: Resend a message to one endpoint

description: Queue one message for redelivery to one endpoint. The usual fix after a customer's endpoint was down. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg/{msg_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/resend.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.
